records.description: DataBank Holdings, Ltd. operates a nationwide digital-infrastructure platform providing colocation, interconnection, cloud, storage, managed security and compliance services to enterprise, cloud, content and technology customers. Founded in Dallas in 2005, DataBank was acquired from Avista by a DigitalBridge-led group in July 2016 and has since expanded through acquisitions, development and multiple recapitalizations. DataBank reported more than 70 data centers in more than 25 markets, 20 interconnection hubs, more than 2,200 customers and more than $1 billion of revenue in May 2026. The current manager-universe ownership roster is DigitalBridge, Swiss Life Asset Managers, IMCO, AustralianSuper, Northleaf Capital Partners, Ardian and CBRE Investment Management. DigitalBridge disclosed a 7.8% continuing stake after the January 2025 secondary. TIAA's Real Estate Account separately disclosed a 14.8% beneficial stake through DigitalBridge Zeus vehicles; DataBank brands that relationship as Nuveen, but it is not evidenced as a Nuveen Infrastructure investment. EDF Invest and TJC are also current investors outside the supplied manager universe. Individual data centers, campuses, interconnection hubs and acquired operating assets remain within the single DataBank platform boundary. No later full sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 18, 2026.

milestones.event: DataBank Ltd. was founded in the former Federal Reserve Bank Building in downtown Dallas, Texas.
Digital Bridge acquired DataBank from Avista Capital Partners with TIAA, Allstate Investments and The Edgewater Funds, launching its first data-center platform.

Colony Capital purchased $185 million of secondary DataBank interests from Edgewater and Allstate; Edgewater exited, Allstate retained half of its prior interest and the Nuveen-branded TIAA investment continued.

A Swiss Life-led consortium with EDF Invest, Northleaf and Ardian closed a collective 35% DataBank interest for approximately $1.5 billion; IMCO then agreed to invest up to $450 million in the continuing recapitalization.

DataBank announced an approximately $2.0 billion equity raise led by AustralianSuper's $1.5 billion commitment, which would make AustralianSuper a significant minority owner; DataBank now lists it as a current investor.

DataBank announced a $250 million TJC investment and an approximately $600 million secondary share sale; DigitalBridge disclosed that the transaction would adjust its continuing DataBank stake to 7.8%.

records.description: Transurban Chesapeake LLC is the concession platform that owns the entities operating the 495, 95 and 395 Express Lanes in Northern Virginia, including the Fredericksburg Extension and 495 NEXT. It develops, finances, operates and maintains dynamically priced express lanes serving motorists, high-occupancy vehicles, buses and permitted commercial traffic in partnership with VDOT. At June 30, 2026, Transurban reported 50% ownership, AustralianSuper 25%, CPP Investments 15% and UniSuper 10%; only AustralianSuper and CPP Investments are tracked infrastructure-manager owners here. records.description: Montreal Gateway Terminals Partnership is a common-user marine container terminal operator at the Port of Montreal. It operates the Cast and Racine terminals as one intermodal platform, providing vessel, yard, reefer, storage, gate and rail/truck-transfer services to global shipping lines and cargo owners serving Canada and the U.S. Midwest and Northeast. The Port of Montreal reports effective handling capacity of 800,000 TEU at Cast and 500,000 TEU at Racine. A consortium led by Fiera Axium Infrastructure acquired 100% of the business from Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners on March 5, 2015; Fiera Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. was the disclosed Axium vehicle, but Axium's individual stake was not published. Axium's live portfolio continues to list the asset as operational. A 2025 debt refinancing identified FA MGT Limited Partnership as the parent but did not transfer equity. Public evidence reviewed did not support carrying the other 2015 consortium members forward as confirmed active owner rows, and no later sale or signed pending exit was found through August 18, 2026. Termont Montreal, the Port authority, and the individual Cast and Racine terminals are not separate companies within this record.

records.description: Cleco Corporate Holdings LLC is the operating parent within the privately held Cleco Group utility platform, serving Louisiana through Cleco Power and related generation assets. The regulated utility serves approximately 298,000 customers across 24 Louisiana parishes and owns eight generating units with 2,676 MW of rated capacity, supported by transmission and distribution networks and approved tariffs. Macquarie Asset Management, BCI and Manulife completed the take-private acquisition on April 13, 2016 and remain the legal owners; their last publicly confirmed 2020 interests were 53.9%, 36.9% and 9.2%, respectively, while exact current percentages are not publicly disclosed. A signed agreement announced April 27, 2026 would sell 100% of Cleco Group to Pine JV Holdings LLC, backed by Stonepeak and Bernhard Capital Partners, but the regulatory proceedings remained open through August 19, 2026, so the existing owners remain active pending closing.

records.description: Mosaic Forest Management is a Canadian timberlands and land-management platform overseeing the TimberWest and Island Timberlands interests across Vancouver Island and coastal British Columbia. Mosaic launched on November 1, 2018. BCI remains the in-scope infrastructure owner through its Infrastructure & Renewable Resources program and reported a 56.1% interest in Mosaic LP at year-end 2025. PSP Investments remains the other legal owner through its Natural Resources mandate; its exact published percentage is not publicly disclosed, and it is not treated as a PSP Infrastructure holding.
